title: Koopman early warning signals for bifurcation and rate-induced tipping
abstract: arXiv:2608.14716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Abrupt transitions in complex systems are often preceded by early warning signals. However, most indicators rely on the notion of critical slowing down and do not generally extend to rate-induced tipping where transitions can occur without local loss of stability. This is problematic in stochastic, nonautonomous systems where internal variability and time-varying variables interact to shape tipping onset. We use Koopman operator theory to develop a unified early warning framework for both bifurcation and rate-induced tipping in stochastic systems. Our approach builds on residual Koopman mode decomposition that measures discrepancies between dynamics and their finite-dimensional approximation, and extends it to the control setting by augmenting the observable space with time-varying control variables. In idealized examples, the resulting indicators recover expected signatures near bifurcation points and improve detection in rate-induced

translated_title: 库普曼算子在分岔与速率诱发突变中的早期预警信号
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14716v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：复杂系统中的突变通常伴随着早期预警信号。然而，大多数指标依赖于临界减速的概念，并且通常不扩展到速率诱发的突变，在这种突变中，转变可以在没有局部稳定性损失的情况下发生。这在随机、非自治系统中是有问题的，其中内部变率和时变变量相互作用以塑造突变的起始。我们使用库普曼算子理论开发了一个统一的早期预警框架，适用于随机系统中的分岔和速率诱发突变。我们的方法基于残差库普曼模式分解，该分解测量动力学与其有限维近似之间的差异，并通过将时变控制变量添加到可观测空间来将其扩展到控制设置。在理想化示例中，得到的指标在分岔点附近恢复了预期的特征，并改善了速率诱发情况下的检测。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于库普曼算子理论的统一早期预警框架，能够同时检测随机系统中的分岔和速率诱发突变，通过残差分解和时变控制变量的扩展提高了预警准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified early warning framework based on Koopman operator theory to detect both bifurcation and rate-induced tipping in stochastic systems, enhancing detection via residual decomposition and time-varying control variables.
